common.adminOnly: Platform admins only: platform support sees this read-only.
common.redacted: Values are redacted before they are stored and again before display; end-user personal data and secrets never appear here.

errors.forbidden: Your platform role does not allow this action.
errors.confirm_required: Confirm the action in the dialog first.
errors.generic: The action failed. Try again; the failure has been recorded.

notices.suspended: The organisation is suspended. Its dashboard, API and processing answer 403 from the next request on; the change is in the audit log.
notices.unsuspended: The suspension is lifted. The organisation can use Track again; the change is in the audit log.
notices.flagRemoved: Override removed; the global default applies again.

suspended.bannerText: Every dashboard page, server action and API request of its members answers 403 with a localized notice. Event processing follows the platform kill switches.
suspended.notice: This organisation is currently suspended by Track. Its dashboard, API and event processing are paused; contact Track support to resolve the suspension.

directory.intro: Every customer organisation with plan, members, sites, usage and health — metadata and aggregates only, never their event data. Tenant details beyond this need a break-glass grant.
directory.exportHint: Metadata only, the same columns as this table, at most {max} rows; every export is recorded in the audit log.
directory.caption: Customer organisations with plan, subscription status, members, sites, accepted events of the last 30 days, last activity and health score
directory.emptyText: Organisations appear here as soon as the first customer signs up.
directory.emptyFilteredText: Loosen the filters or clear the search.
directory.methods: Events: accepted events of the last {eventDays} days from the hourly aggregates. Last activity: newest event aggregate or audit entry within {activityDays} days. Health: rounded average of the latest worker health snapshot per active site; “not measured” means no snapshot exists.

breakGlass.activeText: Grant {id}, read-only, reason: {reason}. Every view of this page is recorded in the audit log with the grant id — the customer sees it in their own audit log.
breakGlass.othersActive: {count, plural, one {# other operator holds an active grant for this organisation.} other {# other operators hold active grants for this organisation.}}
breakGlass.pending: {count, plural, one {# break-glass request is waiting for approval.} other {# break-glass requests are waiting for approval.}}
breakGlass.none: No active break-glass grant: this page shows metadata and aggregates only.

subscription.noRow: No subscription row: the organisation runs on the Starter defaults.
subscription.limitRetention: {count, plural, one {# day retention} other {# days retention}}

policies.cost_limit: Allow overage up to a cost limit
policies.pause: Pause at the limit after the grace window

usage.noPeriod: No usage recorded for {period} yet — the worker writes the counters once events arrive.
usage.historyCaption: Earlier usage periods with accepted, billable and dropped events

members.caption: Members of the organisation with role, two-factor state and join date
members.name: Name
members.invitations: {count, plural, =0 {No pending invitations} one {# pending invitation} other {# pending invitations}}
members.metadata: Team members of the customer — operator-visible metadata. No end-user data.

sites.caption: Sites of the organisation with their environments, published configuration, last events and snippet state
sites.snippetHelp: Verified: browser events were received (the time shown is the last browser event). Pending: a configuration is published but no browser event has been received in the last {days} days. Not installed: nothing published.

destinations.caption: Destinations of the organisation with status, connector health and the worker's latest delivery snapshot
destinations.name: Destination
destinations.noSecrets: Credentials, vendor responses and payloads are never shown here.

signals.countsOnly: Counts and kinds only — issue evidence and alert details stay in the customer's dashboard.

flags.caption: Feature flags with the global default, the organisation's override and the effective state
flags.empty: No feature flags defined yet (Controls module).

dialog.title: Override {key} for {name}
dialog.description: Global default: {defaultState}. The change takes effect for this organisation immediately and is recorded in the audit log with your reason.
dialog.inheritOption: Remove the override (inherit the global default)
dialog.reasonHint: At least 5 characters; ticket reference welcome. Stored on the override and in the audit log.

notes.intro: Internal — only platform operators see these notes; they are never shown to the customer and never contain end-user data.
notes.placeholder: Context for other operators: ticket, agreement, caveat …
notes.limit: The {count} most recent notes are shown.

audit.caption: Latest audit entries of the organisation with actor, action, target and redacted details
audit.limit: The {count} most recent entries are shown; the Audit module has the full log.

suspension.suspendText: From the next request on, every member gets 403 in the dashboard, in server actions and on the API — with a localized notice. Sites, destinations and data stay. The suspension is recorded in the audit log with your reason.
suspension.unsuspendText: The organisation can use Track again immediately. The previous reason and your reason for lifting it are recorded in the audit log.
suspension.reasonHint: At least 5 characters. Internal: shown to operators, not to the customer.
suspension.ticketHint: Optional, e.g. the support or abuse ticket.
